collectionMethod: Read image src attributes from the rendered Wuthering Waves avatar picker using the existing browser session. No account settings were saved. No credentials or personal profile fields are included.
nameReference: research/wiki-avatar-catalog.json; named Wiki avatar entries visually compared to all 58 community originals
indexConvention: zero-based index in the observed DOM order
notes: All originals were fully downloaded and decoded by Pillow; no credentials were used for asset requests.
Avatar picker exposes image URLs but no character names; names are independently confirmed by image comparison.
Image URLs are original URLs with the observed image/resize,w_128,h_128 query removed.
57 images are 500x500; Suoming/锁暝 is only 200x200. Do not upscale and label it high resolution.
500px JPEG Calcharo/卡卡罗 and Verina/维里奈 have white backgrounds and no transparency.
Avatar coverage and ordering describe this observed picker snapshot, not a universal count of all characters or outfits.
